import math

def f(x):
    return math.log(x - 1) / (x - 2) ** 2

def F(x):
    # Antiderivative from integration by parts:
    # F = -ln(x-1)/(x-2) + ln|x-2| - ln(x-1)
    return -math.log(x - 1) / (x - 2) + math.log(abs(x - 2)) - math.log(x - 1)

def simpson(g, a, b, n):
    if n % 2:
        n += 1
    h = (b - a) / n
    s = g(a) + g(b)
    for i in range(1, n):
        s += (4 if i % 2 else 2) * g(a + i * h)
    return s * h / 3
